translation_notes: the single graph.add() becomes one island: OWL_NS.inverseOf -> owl:inverseOf, the two data-derived terms stay interpolations.

OWL_NS = Namespace(...) disappears from the ldpy side, replaced by @prefix owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#> . -- the mechanical draft's 'owl-ns' prefix was renamed to the conventional 'owl'. This is the known asymmetry: @prefix produces no runtime object, so a module that re-exported OWL_NS could not drop it; here nothing else in the region reads it.
